description: Battery level and charging state from a fuel gauge (TinyS3[D]: onboard MAX17048). Optionally records a slow battery stream so a deployment's battery life is in the data file. Drives the power LED (docs/PLAN.md, Status LEDs).

medium_pct.description: Below this: level medium (power LED single pulse).

low_warning_pct.description: Below this: level low (double pulse) and the battery_low event.

critical_pct.description: Below this: level critical (fast flashes) and the battery_critical event.

log_interval_s.description: How often to record the battery stream while recording; 0 = don't record it.

level.description: Band from the thresholds above, with 3 % hysteresis.

charge_rate_pct_per_h.description: Positive while charging, negative while discharging.

gauge_resets.description: Re-estimates this boot (see gauge_reset); absent when none.

full.description: On USB, at least 95 % and the charger has stopped (charge rate ~0) for a minute.

events.battery_low: Battery fell to level low while not on USB power. Once per discharge.
events.battery_critical: Battery fell to level critical while not on USB power. Once per discharge.
events.gauge_reset: The gauge's charge estimate disagreed with the battery voltage by 20+ points after 20 s on battery (typically it started up on the charger's voltage and believed the battery full), so it was told to re-estimate. Detail: percent_before, voltage, percent_from_voltage.
